# EggFights

> Android game based on the Easter egg-tapping tradition (Greek tsougrisma, Serbian tucanje jajima, Romanian ciocnitul ouălor). Two players duel with two phones in the same room; the phones connect directly, no internet needed.

## Facts
- Platform: Android (Google Play)
- Price: free, with optional rewarded video ads; no banner ads, no paywall
- Available in: Serbia, Romania
- Game language: English
- Modes: local two-player duel, local tournament, single-player campaign, EggRun and EggCatcher side games
